narration_focus: A generic claim enters the visual system
visual_design: A restrained title field with one supporting visual anchor
start_state: The topic has not yet been visually established

development_states.description: Introduce the topic and its primary visual anchor

information_peak: The viewer knows the topic and the visual question

reading_hold.reason: Let the viewer register the opening question before development begins

information_delta: The topic gains a clear visual entry point
end_state: The topic anchor can be developed by the next shot
motion_reason: A controlled opening protects the first editorial question

shot_language.selection_reason: The opening shot must orient the viewer before the Beat develops its claim

transition_reason: Open the visual beat with the topic anchor

exit_anchor.description: The primary topic anchor introduced by the shot
